entry.focal: A glowing white hemisphere at the waterline (an uplight poking through the sand), then an orange 20x6 m board standing across the sea mouth, flanked by grey sea-stack boxes.
entry.next_visible: The mouth is visible, but a dull orange wall blocks it. There is no moonlit sea or sky.

reveal.focal: The same white dome and orange board. Flat slabs (surf rocks) float on the dark-blue water.
reveal.next_visible: No, there is nothing beyond the mouth.

concept.focal: The white dome in the foreground. The stalactite cubes and the dark pavilion box at the left. The loungers and lanterns are missing because they are buried.
concept.next_visible: No. The upper beach, pavilion glow and mouth are all dark.

strip.focal: A dark sand slope with a few tiny lantern dots, ending face-to-face with the blank wall of the beach pavilion box (frame 7).
strip.next_visible: No. The spine dead-ends into the pavilion wall and the sea is behind you.

fixes.detail: The beach proxy is a 20x1x6 m opaque orange board standing in the sea mouth at x 198.8, walling off the sea. Remove it and make the mouth an emissive cold sky/sea plane beyond x 200, so moon_sky is the brightest object in the space.

Lounger row dressing0:* and lantern_floor lights0/lights1 were snapped to floor_z -71.0 instead of the beach surface (about -68.5 to -69.4 at x 165-168; dressing1 loungers at the same x sit at -69.4). They are buried 1.5-2 m, which is why the concept view has no loungers or lanterns. Snap them to the terrain.

pool_uplight scatter z -71.0 is below the sea bed (-70.6). At x<176 it pokes out of the beach slope as glowing white domes (lights3:5 at 171.1,30.2; 3:6 at 173.9,20.6; 3:11 at 174.9,40.1; 3:20 at 172.8,47.8). Clip the area to x>=177 and set z = bed - 0.05.

The pavilion sits at z -68.9 vs the intended -67.5, and the spine ends square into its blank side wall. Raise it 1.4 m. End the spine on its deck facing south-east to the mouth, with a lit lantern_hanging cluster at the eave so it is the warm pool at the end of the walk.

33 stalactite_cluster boxes are spread evenly through the edge band and read as a uniform grid of hanging cubes. Put ~70% of them within 10 m of the mouth arch (x>188) so the fringe frames the sky (concept 20).

top_change: Remove the opaque beach board from the sea mouth and make the moonlit opening the brightest, coldest light in B3; then un-bury the loungers and lanterns so the warm beach edge exists.
plausibility: The loungers dressing0:* and lanterns lights0:*/lights1:* are at z -71.0 on a beach whose surface at x~166 is ~-68.5 to -69.4, so they are buried.
The pool_uplights at -71.0 are below the -70.6 sea bed and break the surface of the beach slope near the waterline.
rock_cluster dressing2:* (h 1.2 at -70.85) sit 0.35 m proud of the water and read as floating flat slabs; this is acceptable as surf rocks, but scale them up to 1.4-1.8.
The beach_pavilion is 1.4 m lower than specified, and pavilion_steps (h 0.2) cannot reach a raised deck.
